product_one_liner.value: HeartLegacy, now SalesMail, provides personalized video outreach and AI-powered tour intelligence for sales teams in senior living, home care, and other relationship-driven industries.

pricing_page.notes: The pricing URL displays a demo/contact page, not plans or prices; no public pricing page was found in site navigation.

employee_band.notes: The continuing business under SalesMail lists 36 employees. Legacy HeartLegacy-only profiles conflict: 16–17 employees, corresponding to 11-20; the current unified-brand workforce is used here.

founded_year.notes: 2014 is the founding year of HeartLegacy, not the 2019 launch year associated with SalesMail.

eng_blog.notes: The readable blog contains marketing, sales guidance, customer stories, and product announcements, rather than an engineering blog meeting the two-post requirement.

public_docs.notes: The same company now operates as SalesMail; its public help center contains multiple product articles.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The live board lists Client Success Specialist and Demand Generation Specialist; neither is a qualifying AI/ML/data-science role.

model_provider.notes: The Sidekick privacy disclosure names AWS for transcription and Claude for text analysis, coaching, follow-up drafts, and questions.

compliance_certs.notes: SOC 2 is explicitly in progress, not completed. The privacy policy contains a GDPR statement but does not claim GDPR certification; no completed certification among the five requested is claimed on these pages.

last_funding.notes: The funding database explicitly describes HeartLegacy as unfunded and says it has not raised any funding rounds; a round date and amount are therefore omitted.

raised_18mo.notes: No funding rounds are reported, including within 2025-05-09 through 2026-11-09.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The live board lists Client Success Specialist and Demand Generation Specialist; neither title qualifies under the requested definition.

launched_6mo.notes: SalesMail Sidekick, an AI coaching and tour-intelligence platform, launched on 2026-09-16, within 2026-05-09 through 2026-11-09. SalesMail is the renamed HeartLegacy business, not an unrelated company.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: The small published leadership roster was checked: founders Walt Armentrout and Fran Smith, Corey DeGeorge, Bill McGovern, Reid Gilbert, and Jared Collins. The dated non-founder histories precede 2025-11-09; no qualifying join or departure was found within the window. A title change or the corporate rebrand is not treated as joining or leaving.

crm_stack_signal.notes: These are internal outbound/marketing-stack signals from the job description and marketing leader’s account, not merely customer-facing integration compatibility. Zoho CRM is described as supporting future integrations in the job post and as an established CRM in the marketing leader’s account.
